scientific_integrity: Proof self-contained conditional on the verified rectangular-count, canonical-measure and corner-completion properties from the cited primary source. Finite exact diagnostics are illustrative rather than a substitute for infinite proof. No independent validation or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to nonempty regular extendable planar SFTs with four-way unique corner completion, after a suitable rectangular higher-block presentation. Only integer-direction full-space subaction entropy is claimed; not irrational Milnor entropy, Bernoullicity, uniqueness of MME, or general nonextendable systems.
title: Universal \(\ell^1\) subaction entropy and a common maximizing measure for planar regular subshifts
